items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And on my record that I make for Columbia, there was [Bobi?] [makes sounds], small group type thing, with Ray Brian, Wendell Marshall, who used to play with Duke Ellington and Billy Hart, the drummer.

ctx.x: Ralph Burns, yes. Over the [year?] [inaudible]. I remember Watkins, the bass player.
